Title: Add one valid product to an empty cart
Test data: P41 iMac; quantity 1; displayed unit price $122.00.
Expected result: The notification confirms that iMac was added. Exactly one product row identifies P41, with quantity 1, unit price $122.00 and line total $122.00. The grand total is $122.00 under the common setup.
Evidence to collect: Capture the success notification and the cart row with its quantity and amounts.

Title: Add the same product again
Test data: Existing P41 quantity 1; additional P41 quantity 1; identical product and options.
Expected result: The additional unit is accepted. There is exactly one P41 row, rather than two duplicate rows. Its quantity is 2, its unit price remains $122.00 and its line total and cart grand total are $244.00.
Evidence to collect: Capture the quantity 1 baseline and the resulting single row with quantity 2.

Title: Reject addition when a required option is missing
Test data: P30 Canon EOS 5D; Qty 1; required Select left as --- Please Select ---. Current base price $98.00.
Expected result: The page displays Select required! and does not confirm a successful P30 addition. No P30 row exists in CART. The existing P41 row remains quantity 1 and the grand total remains $122.00.
Evidence to collect: Capture Select required! and CART showing the unchanged P41 row and no P30 row.

Title: Increase the quantity of a cart item
Test data: P41; quantity change 1 to 3; unchanged unit price $122.00.
Expected result: The update succeeds. One P41 row remains with quantity 3, unit price $122.00 and line total $366.00. The grand total is $366.00. Refreshing the page preserves quantity 3 and the amounts.
Evidence to collect: Capture the quantity 1 baseline and the completed quantity 3 result with its amounts.

Title: Reduce quantity to the minimum positive value
Test data: P41; quantity change 3 to 1; unchanged unit price $122.00.
Expected result: The update succeeds without removing P41. Exactly one P41 row remains, with quantity 1, unit price $122.00 and line total $122.00. The grand total is $122.00, and the values persist after refresh.
Evidence to collect: Capture the quantity 3 baseline and the quantity 1 result with its amounts.

Title: Update the last cart item to zero quantity
Test data: P41; quantity change 1 to 0 through the cart quantity field.
Expected result: Characterization expectation: the P41 row is removed, the main cart area displays Your shopping cart is empty!, and no product rows remain. The empty state persists after refresh. Do not require a $0.00 totals table, because the empty-cart page may omit that table.
Evidence to collect: Capture quantity 0 before Update and the resulting main-page empty-cart message.

Title: Remove the only single-unit item
Test data: Only product P41; quantity 1; removal through the row's Remove button.
Expected result: The P41 row is removed. The main cart area displays Your shopping cart is empty! and contains no product rows. A Continue link is available. No checkout is attempted.
Evidence to collect: Capture the single-item baseline and the resulting empty-cart page.

Title: Remove one product while preserving another
Test data: Remove P41 iMac. Retain P30 Canon EOS 5D, Select Red, quantity 1, unit and line price $98.00.
Expected result: P41 is absent. Exactly one product row remains: P30 Canon EOS 5D, Select: Red, quantity 1, unit price $98.00 and line total $98.00. The grand total decreases from $220.00 to $98.00. Refreshing preserves the same product, option, quantity and amounts.
Evidence to collect: Capture both initial rows and the final P30-only cart with grand total $98.00.

Title: Remove an entire multi-unit product row
Test data: Only product P41; quantity 3; one click on Remove.
Expected result: One Remove action deletes all three units in the P41 row. No product rows remain and the main cart area displays Your shopping cart is empty!. Refreshing does not restore the removed item.
Evidence to collect: Capture quantity 3 before removal and the empty-cart state after refresh.
